name: GridCellParams
description: Object passed as parameter in the column [[GridColDef]] cell renderer.

entries.name: field
entries.description: The column field of the cell that triggered the event.

entries.name: row
entries.description: The row model of the row that the current cell belongs to.

entries.name: rowNode
entries.description: The node of the row that the current cell belongs to.

entries.name: colDef
entries.description: The column of the row that the current cell belongs to.
entries.type: Unresolved Type | Unresolved Type | Unresolved Type

entries.name: hasFocus
entries.description: If true, the cell is the active element.

entries.name: api
entries.description: GridApi that let you manipulate the grid.

entries.name: formattedValue
entries.description: The cell value formatted with the column valueFormatter.

entries.name: isEditable
entries.description: If true, the cell is editable.

entries.name: value
entries.description:
The cell value.
If the column has `valueGetter`, use `params.row` to directly access the fields.
